target.title: fix(agents): detect C1 control characters in hasControlCharacter
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`hasControlCharacter()` in `src/agents/failover-error.ts` detects C0 control characters (0x00-0x1f) and DEL (0x7f) but does **not** detect C1 control characters (0x80-0x9f). The C1 range includes the CSI introducer (0x9b) which is an alternative ANSI escape prefix.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `(code >= 0x80 && code <= 0x9f)` to the control character check. Same pattern as:
- #103226 sanitizeForConsole C1 fix
- #103274 renderTerminalBufferText C1 fix

## User Impact

Failover error text containing C1 control bytes is now correctly flagged as control-character-bearing, preventing such text from reaching user-facing error displays.

## Evidence

Same proven pattern — the C1 range (0x80-0x9f) covers all 32 C1 control bytes.

### Files Changed (1 file, +1/-1)

```
 src/agents/failover-error.ts | 2 +-
```
